On May 5, 2025, the Company entered into a credit agreement (the “Credit Agreement”) by and among the Company, its wholly owned subsidiary, DigitalOcean, LLC, as borrower, Morgan Stanley Senior Funding, Inc., as administrative agent, and the other parties thereto for a $500,000 senior secured delayed draw term loan facility (“Term Loan Facility”, and any loans thereunder “Term Loans”) and a $300,000 senior secured revolving credit facility (“Revolving Facility”, and any loans thereunder “Revolving Loans”) which includes a $30,000 sublimit for the issuance of letters of credit (collectively the “2025 Credit Facility”). On May 4, 2026, the Company entered into an amendment to the Credit Agreement (the “First Amendment”), which, among other modifications, (i) increased the Revolving Facility to $412,500, (ii) increased the letter of credit sublimit to $80,000, and (iii) amended the definition of “Indebtedness” to provide that capitalized leases shall be deemed to be an amount equal to 25% of the capitalized amount. The Term Loan Facility and Revolving Facility mature on May 5, 2030, and are subject to a springing maturity date in the event certain conditions occur as described in the Credit Agreement. Revolving Loans may be borrowed, repaid and reborrowed, until their maturity date. Term Loans may be borrowed until February 5, 2026 and, once borrowed and repaid, cannot be reborrowed.

On February 3, 2026, the Company drew down the remaining $120,000 available principal under its Term Loan Facility resulting in a total outstanding principal amount of $500,000. On March 27, 2026, the Company repaid the $500,000 outstanding principal of its Term Loan Facility in cash from the proceeds of its follow-on offering (see Note 11. Stockholders’ Equity) and wrote-off $2,700 of related unamortized issuance cost as loss on extinguishment of debt in other (expense) income, net on the Company’s condensed consolidated statements of operations during the nine months ended September 30, 2026.

The Company was issued letters of credit under the letter of credit sublimit of its Revolving Facility of $9,734 and $15,584 during the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, respectively. No drawdowns have been made under the Company’s letters of credit and the Revolving Facility. The Company’s total available borrowing capacity under the Revolving Facility was $396,916 as of September 30, 2026.

Net cash used in investing activities was $382.0 million and $138.8 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025, respectively. The change was primarily driven by purchases of marketable securities of $177.6 million, a $14.9 million increase in cash payments for capital expenditures, an increase of $47.5 million in cash payments for the acquisition of equipment under financing arrangements (for which we received an equivalent amount of proceeds discussed below in “Financing Activities”), and a $4.0 million payment for acquisition of an AI-related business.

Net cash provided by financing activities was $475.8 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, compared to net cash used in financing activities of $307.2 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2025. The change was primarily driven by proceeds of $1,473.9 million from our direct offering for induced conversion of 2030 Convertible Notes, proceeds of $887.9 million from our 2026 Follow-on Offering, $120.0 million drawdown on our Term Loan Facility and $75.1 million from equipment financing arrangements, partially offset by a $1,478.1 million settlement payment of the 2030 convertible senior notes, $500.0 million repayment of our Term Loan Facility, $62.1 million of payments of employee payroll taxes related to net share settlement of equity awards and $39.9 million of principal repayments for finance leases and financing arrangements for data center equipment.
